div.div: 4 أَصْلَتْ , (T, S, K, TA,) and ↓ صَلِيَتْ , (Fr, K, TA,) and ↓ صَلَتْ , (Zj, TA,) said of a mare, The parts on the right and left of her tail, (صَلَوَاهَا, S,) or the part on either side of her tail, (صَلَاهَا, K, [see صَلًا, below,]) became relaxed, she being near to bringing forth: (S, K:) or, said of a she-camel, her young one fell into the part of her called صَلًا, and she was near to bringing forth. (T, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
